name: Get Child Sample Report
description: Build the full VMRay report of one child sample of a parent sample: analyses, VTIs, MITRE ATT&CK, IOCs, classifications, threat names and screenshots. Fails if the sample is not a child of the parent.

parent_sample_id.description: VMRay ID of the sample the child was found in — e.g. `sample_id` of Get Child Samples.
parent_sample_id.title: Parent Sample ID

child_sample_id.description: VMRay ID of the child to build the report for — e.g. one of the `sample_ids` of Get Child Samples. It must be somewhere in the parent's child tree (up to 10 levels), else the action fails.
child_sample_id.title: Child Sample ID

max_recursion_depth.description: The maximum depth of recursive samples of the child which will be analyzed in the report (at most 10). 0 disables recursion.
max_recursion_depth.title: Max Recursion Depth

ioc_severity_filter.description: Restrict which IOC severities are fetched from VMRay. Allowed values: 'malicious', 'suspicious'. Add exactly one to filter server-side; leave empty (or add both) to fetch both severities. A list with no valid value is an error.
ioc_severity_filter.title: Ioc Severity Filter

analysis_verdict_filter.description: Analysis verdicts to include in the report. Allowed values: 'malicious', 'suspicious', 'clean'. Leave empty to include all analyses, including those with an unknown verdict. A list with no valid value is an error.
analysis_verdict_filter.title: Analysis Verdict Filter

include_screenshots.description: If set to true, the report includes the screenshots of the child sample.
include_screenshots.title: Include Screenshots

results.description:
Only a summary travels inline. The report itself — screenshots included — can be megabytes, far over
Sekoia's limit on action arguments (SYM216), so it is written to data_path and passed on as a file.

report_path.description: Path (relative to data_path) of the full report JSON — give it to Render Report and Extract IOCs as `report_path`.
report_path.title: Report Path

errors.description: Samples that could not be fetched at all, keyed by sample_id — or by 'submission:<id>' when the submission itself could not be resolved to a sample.
errors.title: Errors

results.title: BuildReportResults
